svg.title: Baseline and Extension research workflows
svg.desc: Both workflows share a ReAct model and tools, a PDF parser and a per-run evidence map. The parser reads the source PDF from a file. Parsed papers and run results can be saved to PostgreSQL. Extension adds planning, reflection and retrieval. Its third artifact, Vector, holds document chunk embeddings in a per-paper file cache. Compact mode can compress the context before generation.

g.text: Context compression (compact mode) Under pressure, compact mode trims redundant tool history before a model turn.

g.title: The paper tools share the same parsed document. The parser reads the original PDF from a file.
Parsed pages and original chunks are cached per run with source, page and chunk ID.

g.text: Cited evidence by chunk ID Read, summarized or retrieved passages populate the per-run evidence map. Only cited entries are included in the result's citations.

g.title: PostgreSQL stores the parsed paper and the run result as JSONB when persistence is enabled.
One JSON file per paper caches its document chunk vectors across retrievals.
Retrieve embeds the query for this ranking. Document vectors are computed from paper chunks or reused from the file cache.
